texts.title: The Whip
texts.body: {whip.name} of {whip.house} finds {self.name} in the colonnade before the session with a purse and a smile. There is a motion before the Senate and {self.house}'s vote has a weight. The purse is six credits. The smile says there are other purses.

choices.take_the_coin: Take the purse and promise the vote. Six credits.
choices.name_your_price: No coin — a favour, to be named later.
choices.show_them_the_door: Show the whip the door, purse and all.

texts.title: A Motion Against the House
texts.body: The clerk reads the docket and {self.house}'s name is in it: a motion of censure or embargo, moved by a rival, to be voted next session. The benches are already counting. So should {self.name}.

choices.answer_in_the_chamber: Answer it from the floor. Oratory.
choices.call_in_favours: Spend the night calling in favours (2 influence).
choices.let_them_talk: Let it stand unanswered. Contempt is an argument.

texts.title: The Censure Carries
texts.body: The Senate has censured {self.house}. The clerk's copy is delivered with the seal still warm. Legitimacy bleeds from it; so does the question of what {self.name} does with the chamber's verdict in hand.

choices.bow_to_it: Bow to it and say the words.
choices.defy_it: Tear it in half on the floor. Proud.
choices.remember_who_voted: Say nothing. Write down every name.

texts.title: Recognised
texts.body: The Senate has recognised {self.house}'s title and standing. For a season no one will call the house upjumped where a clerk can hear. The houses that voted it are waiting to see whether the gratitude comes with wine.

choices.a_feast: Give a feast for the houses that voted it. Six credits.
choices.bank_it: Accept it with a nod and go back to work.

texts.title: The Levy Falls Due
texts.body: The Senate's levy has carried: three credits from every landed house to the chair, for the common defence. The chair's collector is polite and early.

choices.pay_and_complain: Pay, and speak for an hour about it.
choices.pass_it_on: Pass it down to the worlds as a tithe.

texts.title: An Act Before the Senate
texts.body: The clerk reads it twice, as the forms require: an Act of the Senate, to bind every house in the Reach when it carries. {clerk.name} folds the paper and looks at the benches, and the benches look at their estates. Every lord in the chamber is doing the same sum {self.name} is.

choices.sound_the_estates: Spend the evening learning what the Act costs whom (1 influence).
choices.let_it_run: Let it run. The Reach's law is the Reach's business.

texts.title: The Act Carries
texts.body: An Act of the Senate has carried, and the law of the Reach has changed under {self.house}'s feet. The clerk's copy arrives for the house's worlds. How loudly it is read is {self.name}'s to decide.

choices.proclaim_it: Have it read in every square, seal first (1 influence).
choices.drag_your_feet: File it where Acts go. The old blood will approve.

texts.title: The Motion Carried
texts.body: {self.house}'s motion has carried the Senate. The chamber is still deciding whether that makes {self.name} a statesman or a nuisance.

choices.press_the_advantage: Make sure every house knows whose motion it was (1 influence).
choices.be_gracious: Thank the opposition for the quality of its opposition.
